source_note: Probe definitions for utils/broker_probe.py. Contact data (opt-out URL, compliance email) is NOT stored here -- it lives in data/brokers.csv, which carries a per-row last_verified stamp and is the single source of truth. This file only describes HOW to query a broker's public search and how to recognise a hit.
how_to_enable_a_broker: Every broker ships in "manual" mode. That is not a placeholder for missing work -- it is the correct default, because a search_template that was never confirmed against the live site produces NO_RECORD for a person who is in fact listed, which is the single most damaging output this tool can emit.

To enable one: (1) open the broker's public search by hand and note the resulting URL; (2) generalise it into search_template using {first} {last} {name} {city} {state}; (3) record a string that appears ONLY on a results-with-hits page (found_strings) and one that appears ONLY on a no-results page (absent_strings); (4) verify both with utils/broker_probe.verify_template() against a name you know is listed and one you know is not -- the same claimed/unclaimed technique Sherlock and Maigret use per site; (5) set mode to "query".
Do not enable a broker whose protection list is non-empty. Those answer automated GETs with a challenge, and the correct handling is the manual row the registry already produces.
